text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were following behind me 
like you usually do, but... it was merely 
a coincidence, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Or are you ready to stand on your own two 
feet? —To run out ahead of me?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
......Well, very well. Either way, the 
gates will open.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much stronger you've 
become... I shall be looking forward to 
seeing it, you know?

—The day of the Shuka Sho has finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotta be Gentildonna! The Yushun 
Himba convinced me. She really is crazy 
strong!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
With a performance like that over 2,400 
meters, she's gonna be on absolute fire in 
the 2,000-meter Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess that's how it feels. 
Verxina is super great too, though.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't you feel like... Verxina just 
kind of fits being Gentildonna's number 
two?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to seeing how they'll 
clash with me, or rather—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —H-Hey!! What a horrible thing to say~!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: !? Wh-Who is it?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis is—! She's definitely not second 
best!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The strongest! The coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I'm number ooooone~!! Got it!?

text_block_list.name: Race Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: V-Verxina... that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! You got ticked off too, 
didn't you, Cheval-chi!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...It's a fact that Ms. Gentil is strong. 
Strong enough to make even my sister feel 
flustered."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why... as long as we believe, we, 
of all people... that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Because surely... that must be what's 
best for my sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, I got a LANE message. It 
said... 'I believe in you.'

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm putting... everything on 
the line today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will throw everything I've built up to 
this point right at them... with all my 
might.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if it ends here, it's so fulfilling 
that I could call it my ultimate wish...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, it was merely a metaphor. 
However, that is genuinely the depth of 
feeling I wish to commit."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because those precious girls I love 
believe in me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it's all right. It's not going 
to end.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: After all, I am invincible.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who told me, a fighting 
spirit that battles for others is my 
greatest weapon—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"As long as that flame burns, I can grow 
stronger. Then, would that not make me 
invincible?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because this flame will never, ever go 
out!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer... Please give me that final 
push!
choice_data_list: Overcome your fear and bring home a win!
Overcome your fear and go win!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Ms. Gentil. Good day to you."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. It seems you've finally awakened.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I woke up a long time ago. If you 
haven't yet, however—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shall I give you a wake-up call? —With the 
shock of defeat!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. A proper lady doing such a thing?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems you still need someone to lead 
the way... and guide you toward your goal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Come right this way, I shall lead you by 
the hand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —You don't mind staying behind me, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm fine. I won't accept anyone's 
help.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
These feelings will carry me all the way 
to victory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —I'll surpass you completely, just watch!
